usage: tunnel reset [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--state] [--requests]
                    [method] [path]

positional arguments:
  method       only this endpoint's state
  path

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json       print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --state      clear script ctx.state and the replay counters (the default)
  --requests   clear the request log
